recommendations.overall_recommendation_summary: To improve your CV and job matching for the position at SynergisticIT, focus on enhancing the clarity of your skills section, adding measurable results to your projects, and addressing the significant gaps in required technologies and frameworks.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Organize Skills Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: The skills section lacks clear organization, making it difficult for recruiters to quickly identify your competencies.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis indicates that the skills section is not grouped or categorized.

recommended_actions.action_description: Organize your technical skills into categories such as Programming Languages, Tools, and Concepts for better clarity.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: Improved readability and clarity of your CV, making it easier for recruiters to assess your qualifications.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Include Measurable Results
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Adding measurable results to your project descriptions can significantly enhance the impact of your CV.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis notes that no measurable outcomes or impacts from projects are included.

recommended_actions.action_description: For each project, add specific metrics or outcomes that demonstrate your contributions and the success of the project.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: Increased effectiveness of your CV by showcasing your achievements and contributions quantitatively.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Add Relevant Work Experience
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Including any relevant internships or work experience can enhance the completeness of your CV.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV currently lacks any work experience, which is a significant gap.

recommended_actions.action_description: If you have completed any internships or relevant work experiences, add them to your CV with descriptions of your responsibilities and achievements.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: Improved completeness and relevance of your CV, making it more appealing to potential employers.
